_readme: Targets the recipe checker holds foam / smoke recipes to. A recipe that goes over is FLAGGED (shown on the card and listed by 'book rebuild'), never refused. A recipe can set lube_ok: true when a long lube is intended.
slick_note: Hellfoam effects play out in 10-15 s; a floor that stays slick much longer only gets in the way.

support._readme: Chemicals that do nothing in the foam / smoke but that the recipe cannot be made without: reagent -> products that need it present. They are not counted as wasted (they still take beaker space, so keep them to the minimum the dispenser allows).

/datum/reagent/stabilizing_agent.why: phlogiston wipes the beaker and starts a 1000 K fireball on the borg unless stabilizing agent is in the beaker when it forms

/datum/reagent/blood.why: the unstable mutagen to blood step of the carpet recipe needs a blood seed to start
